id: 04_Biosafety Procedures Double Bagging of Hazardous Biological Waste
title: 生物安全规程：危险生物废物的双层装袋
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/04_Biosafety Procedures Double Bagging of Hazardous Biological Waste.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/04_Biosafety Procedures Double Bagging of Hazardous Biological Waste/src.py

points.K1: 实验之前，先定废物计划

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，手里拿着两只叠在一起的空白塑料袋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet holding two stacked blank plastic bags and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学一招：生物废物双层装袋。
overlay: 生物安全规程：危险生物废物的双层装袋

shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全柜前做完培养，台面上有用过的吸头和培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes work at a biological safety cabinet; used pipette tips and petri dishes lie on the work surface.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完细菌培养，留下一堆废物。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一只单层袋，犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a single thin blank plastic bag and hesitates.
shots.narration: 他想：随手装一袋，扔掉不就行了？

shots.scene: 小研摇头，举起两只袋子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and holds up two blank bags, one inside the other.
shots.narration: 小研说：要双层装，还得先有计划。

shots.section_title: 实验之前，先定废物计划
shots.scene: 老周和小研在桌前看空白计划表，表上画着废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student review a blank plan sheet with a waste bin icon on it.
shots.narration: 做生物因子实验之前，
overlay: 实验之前，先定废物计划

shots.section_title: 实验之前，先定废物计划
shots.scene: 计划表上三个图标：废物桶、喷壶、灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan sheet with three icons: a waste bin, a spray bottle and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 先想好废物怎么装、怎么处理。

shots.scene: 一只袋子套在另一只袋子里的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of one plastic bag nested inside another plastic bag, with a biohazard symbol on the outer bag. No people.
shots.narration: 双层装袋，是处置生物废物的好办法。

shots.scene: 内袋破了一个小口，外袋把它兜住
shots.prompt_en: The inner bag shows a small tear while the intact outer bag still holds everything inside. No people.
shots.narration: 内袋万一破了，还有外袋兜着。

shots.scene: 小研在柜外把两只袋套进空废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Outside the cabinet, the female graduate student fits two blank bags, one inside the other, into an empty waste bin.
shots.narration: 废物桶进柜之前，先套好两只袋。

shots.scene: 套好袋的桶被放进生物安全柜台面后部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places the double-lined waste bin toward the back of the cabinet work surface.
shots.narration: 柜里少折腾，污染就少。

shots.scene: 阿杰把用过的吸头放进桶里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves and a lab gown, drops used pipette tips into the lined waste bin inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 实验中，废物直接放进内袋。

shots.scene: 小研拿喷壶向内袋口喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant from a blank spray bottle into the open inner bag inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 收口前，向内袋喷消毒剂。

shots.scene: 消毒剂喷雾落进内袋的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fine disinfectant mist falling onto the waste inside the open inner bag. No people.
shots.narration: 让消毒剂覆盖袋里的废物。

shots.scene: 双手把内袋口收拢、拧成一股
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands gather the top of the inner bag and twist it into a neck inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 把内袋口收拢，拧紧。

shots.scene: 胶带和扎带两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a roll of adhesive tape and a zip tie. No people.
shots.narration: 用胶带或扎带，牢牢扎住。

shots.scene: 扎好的内袋口特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the inner bag neck tied tightly with a zip tie. No people.
shots.narration: 扎紧了，里面的东西就出不来。

shots.scene: 双手把外袋提起、包住内袋
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands pull the outer bag up around the tied inner bag inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 接着处理第二层外袋。

shots.scene: 外袋口拧紧并扎好
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands twist the outer bag top and secure it with adhesive tape. No people.
shots.narration: 同样收拢、拧紧，用胶带或扎带扎好。

shots.scene: 两个扎口上下叠在一起的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two tied bag necks, the inner one inside the outer one. No people.
shots.narration: 两道扎口，两道保险。

shots.scene: 小研把扎好的废物袋从桶里提出来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the tied double bag out of the waste bin inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 扎好后，把废物袋从桶里提出。

shots.scene: 袋面上的生物危害标志和高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: A bag with a biohazard warning sign and a small autoclave icon printed on it. No people.
shots.narration: 袋子要耐高压灭菌，有生物危害标志。

shots.scene: 小研向空桶外表面喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant onto the outside of the empty waste bin inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 袋子取出后，给容器表面喷消毒剂。

shots.scene: 空桶表面湿润，旁边画着绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: The empty waste bin stands wet with disinfectant inside the cabinet, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 容器消毒好，下次还能再用。

shots.scene: 废物袋进入高压灭菌器的图标
shots.prompt_en: A tied waste bag moving into an autoclave icon, with an arrow to a disposal truck icon. No people.
shots.narration: 双层装好的废物，可以高压灭菌，

shots.scene: 箭头指向焚烧炉图标，再到对勾
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the autoclave icon to an incinerator icon and then to a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再焚烧，安全处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现套袋、扎口、提袋、喷消毒剂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: lining a bin with two bags, tying a bag, lifting a bag and spraying disinfectant.
shots.narration: 先套两袋，内外分别扎紧。

shots.scene: 桶表面消毒和高压灭菌器、焚烧炉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of spraying a waste bin, an autoclave and an incinerator. No people.
shots.narration: 容器消毒，废物灭菌、焚烧处置。

shots.scene: 计划表和双层袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank plan sheet and two nested bags. No people.
shots.narration: 实验之前，先把废物计划定好。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起扎好的废物袋，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a neatly tied double bag and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 装好每一袋，安全每一天，再见！
